profile.headline: Software Engineer at Recidiviz
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in data analysis, statistics, software development, education, and goat tending. Strong engineering professional with a Ph.D. focused in High Energy Nuclear Physics from University of California, Davis.

positions.title: Field Organizer
positions.description:
-Recruited and managed volunteers in Green and Lafayette Counties
-Managed volunteers in a transition from in-person voter contact to a virtual campaign during the pandemic
-Successfully elected Jill Karofsky to the Wisconsin Supreme Court

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Maintained Wit.ai
-Tech lead on M, a personal assistant and suggestion system inside Messenger
-Taught Algorithms at Morgan State University through FB's Engineer in Residence program
-Machine Learning engineer on Instagram

positions.title: Guest Instructor
positions.description:
-This position was through an exchange program with Facebook
-Developed and taught a 300-level CS course on algorithms while giving students an insight on what it is like to work in industry
-Ran interview training programs twice a week to help prepare students for the dreaded whiteboard interview
-Coached Morgan State's ICPC programming team

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented a Voice Activity Detection system for iOS and Android SDKs.

Acquired January 2015 by Facebook.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.locationName: Davis, CA and Brookhaven National Lab
positions.description:
Analyzed petabyte-scale datasets from a particle collider to isolate rare processes requiring the deployment of C++ across a large server farm.
Reported results in multiple formats, including one-on-one discussions, phone conferences, and large international conferences.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Developed a system using S-Lang to measure stellar elemental abundance ratios independent of plasma temperature profiles using x-ray spectra collected with the Chandra X-Ray Observatory.

company.name: MIT Kavli Institute for Astrophysics and Space Research

positions.title: Lighting Designer and Production Manager
positions.description:
Designing, coordinating, and executing lighting plans for a variety of venues and concerts.

Worked with clients to turn their vision of the event into a reality while staying within their budget. Managed teams of lighting technicians to prepare and run the event.

Designed for a wide range of venues, from 30-person classrooms to 2000+-person event halls.
Worked on myriad events, including concerts (Cake, Ozomatli, Freezepop, Yin Yang Twins, and others), corporate shareholder meetings, musicals, dance performances, video lectures, academic conferences, theatrical events, and more.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Developed, debugged, and deployed an array of magnetic flux probes to instantaneously map magnetic fields in fast spontaneous reconnection experiments using the Versatile Toroidal Facility.

company.name: MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center

publications.title: Suppression of Upsilon Production in d+Au and Au+Au Collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 200 GeV
